notes.title: Castle's Reshaping
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to the new devlog from the Dracula’s Castle! 🧛 Today, we’ve prepared a few different novelties which in our opinion will be much to your liking. Without further ado let’s dig into them! 
New room type which can be used to shape the castle according to the player's desired look! 🤩🔥 More secrets in store for these rooms… Will you be able to discover them and use their full potential?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/5604c7d1805a8d97852b6cd7a60e88b9797624e9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Notification System[/b][/h3] 

The notification system has been completely re"vamped" 🦇. Game conditions will now trigger notification icons with tooltips. If the conditions are resolved, the icons will self-dismiss. Alternatively, the player can also right-click to dismiss them. They will then collapse properly in the UI. 📝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/8ce3f477c4e7de86293bc2c97695e777d1640fe2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Exterior Decoration System[/b][/h3]

A new meta-type of room has been added requiring some serious rewiring of the grid system. Now players can place external decorations such as towers, spires, gargoyles, etc... The new system can now also handle rooms with multiple levels, for added verticality to the castle builds. 🔨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ac9a55b9ecb88b7a130c08b772e4fab6fa91db95.gif[/img]

[h3][b]More Tooltips[/b][/h3]

Dracula's Castle, now with even more tooltips! Many missing tooltips have been added to the UI which will result in a more pleasant experience throughout the entire gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/4a22f315a0a997f9c79b26648b853a6014f2221e.png[/img]

[h3]That’s it for today! If you enjoyed the contents of today’s devlog please[b] join our discord community 👇 and wishlist the game on Steam![/b] 💪[/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DWUWJy9VTw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/ 

See you soon
Dracula's Castle Team

notes.title: Dining with New Friends
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello! 👋[/b][/h1]

Creatures of the night have been really restless recently, hence the lack of the news. Finally, our spy managed to escape and share with us the latest affairs of Dracula's Castle. 🦇

The first abnormal change is enormous amounts of water and food entering the castle. Have the minions of the Count become affected by[b] thirst and hunger[/b]? 🤔 

[h3]Based on this information we’ve created a theory:[b] if the castle runs low on food, its resource production will take a big hit[/b], on top of that [b]Dracula won’t be able to feed on his minions[/b] because of their weakened state. If they[b] run out of water, his creatures will suffer even worse[/b]! 📝[/h3]

The castle also undergoes some changes. We’ve discovered some works on[b] decorative rooms [/b] 🧱 such as towers,spires etc… They’ve also started building[b] corridors 🔨 and plan to add various traps [/b]inside. Are they afraid of [b]vampire hunters’ raid[/b]? On top of that doors are now added to the side rooms of the castle so there is no more falling out. 🚪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/d97b416c0dd74f41a84dfdac02f4cc4b9bcc768f.png[/img]
New room has been built. [b]A spacious dining room appeared inside the castle[/b]. 🍽️ Is Dracula planning to seduce victims and kidnap them to the castle where he can do whatever he wants with them? 😨 We’ll do our best to find out his plans in the next report.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/fec355ddb7c22e5e6c4863daa134a9e2cfa2111e.png[/img]
We’ve also been notified about [b]new music themes[/b] inside the castle. Scary as they are, one cannot deny them adding to the atmosphere of the place. 🎵

As for the final change, a [b]tooltip appeared for each raw resource[/b] so managing the production chains became easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/3ba690983a39fa642e97816a2bff8f37e713702d.png[/img]
Thank you for reading the entire report. [b]If you have any opinions on it or ideas what are the following steps of Dracula 🧛 please join discord and let us know[/b]! 👇 You can also add the game to your wishlists to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/

See you soon,
Dracula’s Castle Team

notes.title: Resource Management!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to Dracula's Castle! 👋 🧛[/b][/h1]

[h2]We are grateful you’ve accepted the invitation of our humble lord, progenitor of the vampires- Dracula. 🦇 [/h2]

Today, we’d like to talk some more about the topic we’ve mentioned last month- the raw resources as well as some of the improvements introduced to the castle! 🤩

On top of the already existing raw resource rooms, we’ve decided to introduce two entirely new! They are connected with each other and undoubtedly worth the materials required for construction. 

[h3]The first of the new raw resource rooms added is [b]The Timber Store[/b]! 🪓 It produces the wood material, which is further processed in the second raw resource room - [b]The Sawmill[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/a1a052efe4fd5a2ef8af80d9296c0c2b579d6e74.png[/img]
[h3]Speaking of Sawmill, this room will take the wood from the Timber Store and produce lumber out of it. Do not neglect the importance of this resource as it is now a requirement for building certain rooms! 🔨🧱[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/7a98ed2987ed250b718e1654970bb88918ab6210.png[/img]
There is a new, huge change introduced to the game also connected with the resources- [b]Power Management[/b]. Most rooms require dark power acquired from the Blood Crystals. 🩸 If the power level drops below the required threshold, rooms will stop the production until the power issues are resolved. We’ve got a suggestive red lighting to indicate the rooms affected by the power loss. 💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/3986d63759de85d8529985819445c6f5619d22f9.png[/img]
The last novelty we’ve prepared for today is a quality of life improvement- a [b]multiple active quests support[/b]! 👏 The quests are no longer limited to a linear sequence, below we’d like to showcase that functionality. The player is told they must produce new sails in the appropriately named quest “Sails”. However, in order to build the required rooms they must also construct the Timber Store and Sawmill, which is a task given in the quest “Industry”. 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/bdc53ce57ad4bf3f4412cf5c379632f5c9901f05.png[/img]
That’s it for today! What do you think about the contents of this month’s devlog? Join our discord 👇 and let us know! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DWUWJy9VTw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url] 

Don’t forget to add our game to your wishlists 👇 as more information is just around the corner and trust us, you don’t want to miss it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/ 

See you soon,
Dracula’s Castle Team

notes.title: New Resources
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]It’s been a while since the last devlog but [b]we’re very excited to share the current progress with you![/b][/h2] 🤩

[h3]There are[b] lots of changes[/b] and the first of them[b] happened in your castles[/b]! 🏰 From now on [b]your Peons and Laborers will now wander around the rooms[/b]. They no longer just stand still and look into the camera! 🚶[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/db5ec442d2f55eae848d0f80065834066492e0d4.gif[/img]
Speaking of your servants… The NPC cards received an update and expansion as well! [b]All the NPCs now have dynamic statistics[/b] which are displayed in the mentioned [b]NPC cards[/b]. 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ff096fd819979537c13337388aebeeb3bebb2bdd.png[/img]
[h3]What’s more, we’ve introduced a[b] new kind of in game resources- Raw Resources[/b]. ⛏️ Unlike the dynamic basic resources (namely water, food and power), they aren’t collected by clicking on the icon appearing on the room.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/7cd9c1f2736962efe90a3e079985d73193cfc7f4.png[/img]
They are important because of multiple different uses. Some of the activities will require them, for example:
- some buildings will require both blood and wood to be built,
- some quests will require a certain production output of a resource, 
- some rooms will require resources to be able to produce something. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/44c2dcd32add7eaa932ec7107932e379fba5d465.png[/img]
We’ve also upgraded the[b] room detail view[/b]. From now on it has a [b]card showing production output [/b]if it’s a room producing raw resources.

[h3]That’s not the end! [b]We’ve introduced primary and secondary stat affinities in those rooms![/b] 💪[/h3]

[h3]Pay close attention to them as[b] assigning workers with matching affinities will give you a BOOST ⬆️ to production[/b] in that room! 
[/h3]
In the example below assigning a peon with high Constitution (CON) and Strength (STR) will grant you the best bonus! 📝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/d2ec16f3c6c142957fabbc416d5399aca5378dd1.png[/img]
That brings us to an end of this devlog but we’ll show you even more novelties next month! Therefore, we invite you to [b]add Dracula’s Castle to your wishlists[/b] 👇 [b]and join our discord community[/b] 👇 to not miss on any further update!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DWUWJy9VTw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/ 


See you soon,
Dracula's Castle Team

notes.title: Quests and Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Creatures of the night, 🧛[/b][/h1]

[h2][h3]In today’s devlog we’ve got [b]plenty of news[/b] straight from Dracula's Castle 🏰, Transylvania. The main being the [b]creation of Tavern[/b] 🍻. [/h3][/h2]

The place is to become [b]essential[/b] in your future adventures as it’s the first [b]quest hub[/b] in our production. 🤩

[h3]Speaking of quests - we’ve added 2️⃣ [b]new quests[/b] as well as a [b]new mechanic[/b] being the time limited quests.[/h3]

[h2]To make sure you’ll enjoy interacting with the in game characters 🧍 we’ve been working on the [b]new dialogue system[/b] 💬 which now supports [b]branching dialogue[/b]! 😍
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/d187b7d4cc49557104083bb69c2a841bfc97aa9f.gif[/img]


We know that from time to time even the most committed vampire needs a break from the blood 🩸, that’s why the water was changed and now is  a collectible resource. 💧

[h3]Not only have we improved the dialogue system but also worked on the fighting mechanics! ⚔️[/h3]

Your [b]upcoming battles[/b] are to become [b]more challenging[/b] ⚠️ as from now on, you can be fought by [b]multiple enemies simultaneously[/b]. 😱 The [b]post processing[/b] has also been added for [b]better visuals[/b]. You’ll also know exactly what you’ve gained after defeating your opponents thanks to the [b]loot grid[/b] added to the victory screen ✌️🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/4f222991aaca3af085b1df89983ae08311d80cda.png[/img]

[h3]We’ve also made sure to let you all [b]track your stats[/b] with the [b]Dracula panel[/b]. This panel will also feature the [b]talent tree[/b] we plan to implement later on. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/9853dd752d07b7af4b86b0889cd8d9b8b8bca07c.png[/img]

[h2]We are also working on [b]steam achievements[/b] with the [b]first one already added[/b] on the platform 😀[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/c8a1d4d940d730caa74e8959503cfb0104b5e8a3.png[/img]

There are also [b]many[/b] smaller but not less significant [b]changes[/b] we’ve made to the game. Dracula now heals while staying in the castle and the game tracks his location more consistently - no more teleporting. Expanding the castle upwards is also going to require an ever increasing amount of resources. 

[h3]Last but not least, technical upgrades! 🤖
[list]
[*] More UI and font improvements ✔️
[*] Ultrawide resolution support added ✔️
[*] Performance and loading improvements in the castle scene ✔️
[*] Rebalanced sound throughout the game ✔️
[*] Credits button added to main menu ✔️
[/list][/h3]

We [b]value your opinions[/b] and want our production to [b]meet your expectations[/b]. Please [b]give us your suggestions[/b] in the comments below 👇  this devlog and[b] join our discord[/b] to discuss with other members of the community. To make sure you don’t miss on any further updates please [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b]. 👇 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DWUWJy9VTw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/

See you soon,
Dracula’s Castle team

notes.title: Game Mechanics, New Units and Locations 📖
notes.content:
[h1][b]Evening Vampires![/b]🦇[/h1]
Creatures of the Night, tonight we will be talking about the ongoing development of Dracula’s Castle. We’ll go over some new mechanics, new unit types and leveling them up and new locations. 🌃

Let’s get into it! 😈

[h2][b]Draining Your Victims![/b] 🩸[/h2]

You can no longer feast upon your victims indefinitely. Townspeople will become increasingly wary 😱 after each of your attacks, and thus the chance of your failure will increase. 📈

If that wasn't enough, it will be very easy to exaggerate the amount of [b]blood[/b] you drink from a person - there is a chance of their death, and this will make Dracula’s time in town more difficult. ☠

On the positive blood type side (heh, get it?) victory in battle will result in a modest blood gain. ⚔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/f594eab27f0d704cbe06ce2b8cd48bb1cf7f6094.gif[/img][h1]

[h1][b]UI Improvements[/b] 🤓 [/h1]
Hovering over UI Buttons now highlights them! We also cleaned up non-decorative game text fonts. All this to make the game easier and more enjoyable for you to play. 😀

Some rooms are locked behind certain conditions. For example, to unlock the wells you may need to get more [b]peons[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/d59d558236c7869b7bf6745699ad9acb72cde0b8.png[/img]

We’ve also added a new notification banner, there will be notifications for important events. 😮
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/aa7dde3437f9ef201d88e894646c84b0c7dd30d7.gif[/img]

The minion card is now ✨dynamic ✨ and properly showing NPC information.
Now you can also scroll through tasks in the Quest Journal! 📱

[h1][b]More Workers to Manage[/b] 🧛‍♂️[/h1]

That's exactly right. From now on, one of your tasks will be to take care of your subordinates. For example, [b]Peons[/b] will need food and water and small quarters to survive. You'll have to pay close attention to making sure their needs are met properly! 👩‍🍳

We have also expanded the gameplay with a completely [b]NEW[/b] type of [b]NPC[/b] - [b]LABORERS[/b]! 
[b]Laborers[/b] will need a bit more space to function properly and have new requirements to keep them satisfied. The good news is that you will get a passive blood bonus if you look after them. This means more resources to collect, more upgrades and more thinking. 🤔


The most important question - How to get more workers? [b]Peons[/b] will hear of work opportunities at the castle and can be promoted to [b]Laborers[/b]. However, you can also find some in the towns and cities, with the help of a recruitment [b]minigame[/b]. 📱

Have fun! 🤗

Happy worker = more “donations” for Dracula…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/919a5561bb24806bb0b0ee526c4212552290d9f3.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Make Some Room(s)![/b] 👷‍♂️[/h1]

Personnel is not the only thing you will need to take care of, introducing 3 new rooms to put your precious ✨ workers in:


[b]FIRST[/b] | Medium Quarters: [b]LABORERS[/b] have earned some nicer rooms. They might sleep better at night... But then again... 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/c5d04aa19ab1a3c9c64ae71da227c9fcf350bdb5.png[/img]
[b]SECOND[/b] | Beastmaster’s room: This hairy guy looks after the castle's pets. Primary provider of wool. 🐑 (You can’t see him at the moment, he is in the shadows) 🐱‍👤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/7a2f9e6a1f713e2508a994a6e4849113b2e22aa2.png[/img]

[b]THIRD[/b] | Weaver: This happy chappy operates the mystical loom to make blankets and coats, which helps with your workers' needs, and this is their office! 🤗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/f7fe973725deb4d6219f5881b463d66b189b12ad.png[/img]

[i]Psst! Surfacing bugs are being fixed as they come up![/i] 👨‍💻

And that’s all the news from Transylvania! 

Hope you’re as excited as we are and if you want to talk about it, join our [b]Discord[/b]! (link below) Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get a notification as soon as the game comes out!  ✨

[url=https://discord.gg/2jah8pmY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
The Dracula’s Castle Team

notes.title: Dracula in the Throne Room
notes.content:
[h1][b]👋  Hello Players!  👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are getting closer and closer to the holiday that is Halloween, and in connection with this, Dracula has arrived in his castle throne room!  🧛🏻‍♂️
Are you curious to find out what spooky novelties have arrived in the game, along with the king of darkness? 👀[/h3]

We invite you to read the next devlog 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/f2e9801954ed72af2cd3b5e3af89bc9fc2166fd9.png[/img]


[h2][b]Dracula in the Throne Room  👑[/b][/h2]

[b]As befits a throne room, it will be a kind of "command center" for our castle. What can we do from here exactly, you ask? Behold:[/b]

🌳  From the throne room you will be able to access Dracula’s tech tree
💰  See your inventory and manage your equipment 
🌃  And send Dracula to scour the areas around Transylvania! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/caf8e4675e46cf5247f658d95685c06665c811cd.gif[/img]



[h2][b]Another amazing thing we managed to implement into the game is a task system! 🔍[/b][/h2]

This is a fully working quest system that replaces the old static log page! You will not only be able to track the progress of the main quest, but also building quests and side quests involving some of the main characters in the game.

[b]This is definitely a big part of this milestone that we are very proud of  🤩 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/7016d015eae69aed4158f8e756cb03ed0ab0318f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/0bcf3ef240c68820325582eb5f8686d731c7c832.gif[/img]

[h2][b]What else are we working on ❓[/b][/h2]

Castle employees now have tiers and a satisfaction system, which means they can be upgraded!
Everything will, of course, depend on properly maintained conditions. You’ll need to keep them fed and plump to get the most out of them  😎

notes.title: Castle Chambers
notes.content:
[h1][b]🦇 Hello Players! 🦇[/b][/h1]

[h3]The production of our game has been going on for some time and you can see the first entries about it [url=https://astirian-raegames.com/]HERE[/url]
Over several posts, we share some of the development journey and explain some of the core concepts and design choices behind Dracula’s Castle.[/h3]

From now on, we will also regularly publish devlogs here - [b]on Steam[/b] - so you can follow the development of our game together with us!
The updates will appear[b] every month[/b], and we really hope you will like them 🔥


[h2][b]Today’s theme is castle chambers. Here’s a preview of two room types that we will be able to build in our castle!  🏰[/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/a52a299546cd6353ba19648105197ee9ccb34e5d.gif[/img]


How many rooms you build will determine how many workers and minions you can have. These rooms will be divided into two types:

[b][list]
[*] Tombs
[*] Bedrooms
[/list][/b]

[b]How quickly you get to travel to England on the Demeter will depend on their number, so manage your resources and build appropriate rooms to develop your strategy, all while discovering new mechanics and achieving your goal![/b]


In addition to the room mechanics, a large number of tombs will give additional [b]skill bonuses[/b] to the undead minion class.

Do you like wolves? Build more kennel rooms and give them extra specs!  🐺
Or maybe you would like Dracula to also get passive, dark bonuses?  🧛🏻‍♂️

Build and discover more suitable rooms to suit your playstyle ❗


[h3][b]Our game is still in development, so the topic of building is something we will definitely be revisiting in future devlogs.
If you have any questions or would like to talk to the game’s creator, please visit our Discord:[/b][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/vBPnghFU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/ece3e8bae37f752dca5543f3e666c6ecdcd7073d.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]Also, don't forget to add Dracula’s Castle to your Steam Wishlist and stay tuned for more updates on the game’s development![/b][/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502050/Draculas_Castle/


See You soon,
The Dracula’s Castle Team

notes.title: Dracula's Castle - Official Teaser
notes.content:
The new teaser trailer is done!

We're happy to announce that the Dracula's Castle now has a teaser. :)=

And just in time for Halloween too! It hints at some of the mechanics in the game. If you have a close look you should be able to spot some of the milestones from the previous updates, plus a few extra goodies:

- Improved graphics on the rooms, with post-processing effects enabled.
- The map travel system, with Dracula's arrival to one of the local towns.
- The feeding mechanic with its fully physical dice and NPC biometrics.
- The combat system! An early peek at the combat arena and turn-based combat.

Finally a glimpse at Dracula's throne room! This is where you'll decide on Dracula's particulars and strategy.

We really hope you like it and please feel free to provide feedback and ask any questions!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520183/578f2a66dc606a604594c691fbdb123745f10e1b.png[/img]


Best Regards,
Astirian-Rae Games
